fuentes.evidencia: High Velocity Hurricane Zones are defined in Section 202 of the FBC as Dade and Broward Counties.

aprobacion_productos.hecho: En HVHZ los productos de envolvente deben estar evaluados a las secciones HVHZ del FBC; la NOA de Miami-Dade (Product Control) es la aprobación local para HVHZ.

fuentes.evidencia: Products that receive a Notice of Acceptance (NOA) (product approval) from Miami-Dade County must meet the requirements for Florida's High Velocity Hurricane Zone (HVHZ) ... Miami-Dade's Product Control Section reviews and issues approval or denial of building construction materials, products and systems used for the protection of the building envelope, mainly addressing windows, exterior glazing, wall cladding, roofing, exterior doors, skylights, glass block, siding and shutters.
NOAs are also processed for products such as fences, A/C stands, pre-cast items, railings, screen enclosures, plumbing fixtures, awnings, concrete reinforcement, and plastic components.
Título: 'ADVANCED NAVIGATING INTO MIAMI-DADE NOA'S AND FLORIDA PRODUCT APPROVALS' (material de curso alojado en floridabuilding.org).

aprobacion_productos.dudas: No se encontró snippet oficial de Broward/floridabuilding.org que diga literalmente 'en Broward se exige NOA o FL Product Approval HVHZ'. La frase 'Dade and Broward counties are designated as HVHZ areas and require approvals be evaluated to the HVHZ sections of the FBC' se vio en floridaroof.com (FRSA, asociación, NO oficial). Las frases de miamidade.gov hablan de Miami-Dade; un NOA de miamidade.gov decía que fuera de Miami-Dade y Broward está la non-HVHZ. Redactar con prudencia: 'productos aprobados para HVHZ (p. ej. NOA de Miami-Dade)'.

sfwmd.evidencia: The Year-Round Landscape Irrigation Conservation Measures Rule (Chapter 40E-24, Florida Administrative Code) limits landscape watering to two days a week throughout the South Florida Water Management District, with a three-day-a-week provision for some counties ... A provision in the rule allows for three-day-a-week irrigation in counties south of Lake Okeechobee, including Broward ... The rule has been in effect since March 2010.

broward.evidencia: Year-round irrigation restrictions are mandatory in Broward County for all cities, with NO watering of lawns and landscapes allowed on Monday, Tuesday, and Fridays. Residences and businesses with an odd-numbered street address may water ... on Wednesdays and/or Saturdays, only before 10:00 a.m. or after 4:00 p.m. ... even-numbered street address, no street address ... Thursdays and/or Sundays ... reclaimed water ... any day only before 10 a.m. or after 4:00 p.m.
broward.nota: La página se titula 'Mandatory Irrigation Restrictions' y dice que aplican a todas las ciudades; que sea una ordenanza del condado (número/código) NO se vio en snippet. Un snippet de sfwmd.gov dijo además que 'local ordinances limit landscape irrigation to two days a week in Broward'.
